verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετ’ ἐμοῦ λέγων Ἀνάβα ὧδε καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta eidon kai idou thyra ēneōgmenē en tō ouranō kai hē phōnē hē prōtē hēn ēkousa hōs salpingos lalousēs met’ emou legōn Anaba hōde kai deixō soi ha dei genesthai meta tauta
verses.literal: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying Come up here and I will show you what must happen after these things
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, olhei, e eis uma porta aberta no céu e a primeira voz que ouvi ( como de trombeta, falando comigo), dizendo: Sobe para aqui, e mostrar-te-ei o que deve acontecer depois dessas coisas.

verses.original: εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν Πνεύματι καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος
verses.transliteration: eutheōs egenomēn en Pneumati kai idou thronos ekeito en tō ouranō kai epi ton thronon kathēmenos
verses.literal: At once I was in the Spirit and I saw a throne standing in heaven with someone seated on it
verses.literalPt: Imediatamente, fui arrebatado pelo Espírito. Eis havia um trono posto no céu, e, sobre o trono, um sentado;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ
verses.transliteration: kai ho kathēmenos homoios horasei lithō iaspidi kai sardiō kai iris kyklothen tou thronou homoios horasei smaragdinō
verses.literal: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian . . . and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne
verses.literalPt: e aquele que estava sentado era, pelo que parecia, semelhante a uma pedra de jaspe e de sardônio; e havia ao redor do trono um arco-íris semelhante, pelo que parecia, à esmeralda.

verses.original: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρες καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς
verses.transliteration: kai kyklothen tou thronou thronous eikosi tessares kai epi tous thronous eikosi tessaras presbyterous kathēmenous peribeblēmenous en himatiois leukois kai epi tas kephalas autōn stephanous chrysous
verses.literal: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white with golden crowns on their heads
verses.literalPt: Estavam também ao redor do trono vinte e quatro tronos; e sobre os tronos vi sentados vinte e quatro anciãos vestidos de roupas brancas, e, nas suas cabeças, coroas de ouro.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ἅ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ek tou thronou ekporeuontai astrapai kai phōnai kai brontai kai hepta lampades pyros kaiomenai enōpion tou thronou ha eisin ta hepta Pneumata tou Theou
verses.literal: From the throne came flashes of lightning rumblings and peals of thunder Before the throne burned seven torches of fire These are the seven spirits of God
verses.literalPt: Do trono saem relâmpagos, vozes e trovões. Diante do trono ardiam sete lâmpadas de fogo, que são os sete Espíritos de Deus;

verses.original: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσαρα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν
verses.transliteration: kai enōpion tou thronou hōs thalassa hyalinē homoia krystallō kai en mesō tou thronou kai kyklō tou thronou tessara zōa gemonta ophthalmōn emprosthen kai opisthen
verses.literal: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass as clear as crystal In the center - around the throne were four living creatures covered with eyes in front and back
verses.literalPt: diante do trono havia um como mar de vidro, semelhante ao cristal; no meio do trono e ao redor do trono havia quatro criaturas viventes, cheias de olhos por diante e por detrás.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ἔχων τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς ἀνθρώπου καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ
verses.transliteration: kai to zōon to prōton homoion leonti kai to deuteron zōon homoion moschō kai to triton zōon echōn to prosōpon hōs anthrōpou kai to tetarton zōon homoion aetō petomenō
verses.literal: The first living creature was like a lion the second like a calf the third had a face like a man and the fourth was like an eagle in flight
verses.literalPt: A primeira criatura era semelhante a um leão, a segunda, criatura semelhante a um novilho, a terceira criatura tinha um rosto como de homem, e a quarta criatura era semelhante a uma águia que voa.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ἓν καθ’ ἓν αὐτῶν ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες Ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος
verses.transliteration: kai ta tessara zōa hen kath’ hen autōn echōn ana pterygas hex kyklothen kai esōthen gemousin ophthalmōn kai anapausin ouk echousin hēmeras kai nyktos legontes Hagios hagios hagios Kyrios ho Theos ho Pantokratōr ho ēn kai ho ōn kai ho erchomenos
verses.literal: And each . . . . . . of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within Day and night they never stop saying Holy Holy Holy is the Lord God Almighty who was and is and is to come
verses.literalPt: As quatro criaturas, tendo cada uma delas seis asas, são cheias de olhos ao redor e por dentro. Não têm descanso dia e noite, dizendo: Santo, Santo, Santo, é o Senhor Deus, o Todo-Poderoso, o que era, que é e o que há de vir.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan dōsousin ta zōa doxan kai timēn kai eucharistian tō kathēmenō epi tō thronō tō zōnti eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: And whenever the living creatures give glory honor and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Quando aquelas criaturas viventes derem glória, e honra, e ações de graças ao que está sentado sobre o trono, ao que vive pelos séculos dos séculos,

verses.original: πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: pesountai hoi eikosi tessares presbyteroi enōpion tou kathēmenou epi tou thronou kai proskynēsousin tō zōnti eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn kai balousin tous stephanous autōn enōpion tou thronou legontes
verses.literal: the twenty-four . . . elders fall down before the One seated on the throne and they worship Him who lives forever and ever They cast their crowns before the throne saying
verses.literalPt: os vinte e quatro anciãos se prostrarão diante daquele que está sentado sobre o trono, e adorarão ao que vive pelos séculos dos séculos, e lançarão as suas coroas diante do trono, dizendo:

verses.original: Ἄξιος εἶ ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας τὰ πάντα καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Axios ei ho Kyrios kai ho Theos hēmōn labein tēn doxan kai tēn timēn kai tēn dynamin hoti sy ektisas ta panta kai dia to thelēma sou ēsan kai ektisthēsan
verses.literal: Worthy are You our Lord and God to receive glory and honor and power for You created all things by Your will they exist and were created
verses.literalPt: Tu és digno, Senhor nosso e Deus nosso, de receber a glória, e a honra, e o poder, porque tu criaste todas as coisas, e, pela tua vontade, existiram e foram criadas.
